land: Europa (studiene om gradering fra Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Finland)
sitat: In the present review, graded sickness-absence certificates, PTSL, and multidisciplinary, coordinated and tailored return to work interventions were effective in improving the employment status, return to work and sick leave outcomes of persons with chronic conditions living in Nordic countries.
